title: DPIIT Offline Internship Scheme
description: An offline internship program at the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade providing exposure to government functioning.
eligibility: Engineering/Management students in 3rd or 4th year.

title: Smart India Hackathon 2026
description: National level hackathon demanding innovative hardware and software solutions to solve real-world problems.
eligibility: All enrolled engineering students.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Skill development initiative providing industry-relevant skill training to youth.
eligibility: Indian youth looking for skill certification.

title: ISRO — IIRS External Student Internship
description: Short-term internship in remote sensing, GIS, geospatial technology and related research.
eligibility: Indian citizens pursuing UG/PG/PhD in Science or Technology, or who completed within the last six months; minimum 60% or CGPA 6.32/10.

title: MoEFCC Internship Scheme
description: Government internship involving environmental policy, climate, forestry and sustainability research.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by the scheme's prescribed educational qualifications and subject areas; use the official eligibility checker.

title: NITI Aayog Internship
description: Monthly application window for students interested in public policy, economics, technology and research.
eligibility: Undergraduate students must have completed or appeared in second-year/fourth-semester exams and secured at least 85% in Class 12.

title: IIT Bhubaneswar Winter Internship 2026
description: Short winter research programme across engineering, sciences, management and other disciplines.
eligibility: Students enrolled in a degree programme at an academic institution; selection by the relevant department.

title: DRDO DRDE Paid Internship
description: Research internship opportunity in defence-related science and engineering.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the specific DRDE advertisement, degree/branch and academic criteria. Check the official notice before applying.

title: AICTE National Internship Portal
description: Search internships across IT, engineering, business, design, marketing and other fields.
eligibility: Varies by internship; check the specific listing for eligible qualifications, branches, year of study, minimum marks and required skills.

title: COLOSSUS 3.0
description: A student hackathon covering AgriTech, FinTech, cybersecurity, HealthTech, hardware/IoT and open innovation. Includes an online idea-screening round and a 24-hour offline finale in Bengaluru. Prize pool: ₹1 lakh+.
eligibility: UG and PG students; inter-college teams allowed.

title: Cyber Hackathon 2026
description: A cybersecurity competition to develop practical defences against digital threats. Teams select a published problem, build a solution and submit their code and demo video.
eligibility: Students enrolled at a recognized college or university in India; every member must provide a valid college ID.

title: SAARTHI-26
description: A 36-hour hackathon where student teams develop technology solutions to real-world problems. Suitable for both beginners and experienced developers.
eligibility: Students currently enrolled in an educational institution anywhere in India.

title: INNOVASIA 2026
description: A multi-domain hackathon with themes including FinTech, cybersecurity and blockchain, smart automation, and agriculture and rural development. The initial round involves an idea presentation.
eligibility: Undergraduate students from any college or university.

title: Bits2Wave 2026
description: A hardware-and-software hackathon where teams submit a project idea and presentation before shortlisted teams advance to the final round. Prize pool: ₹60,000.
eligibility: Undergraduate students from any college or university.

title: SpectoV National Hackathon — SNH 26
description: An individual-entry competition focused on AI, app development and web development. The organizer advertises ₹5.5 lakh+ in prizes and a potential six-month paid internship for selected performers.
eligibility: Check the official rules for detailed age, education and participation conditions.

title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: Scholarships for college students, including merit-based and category-specific financial assistance.
eligibility: Depends on the scheme, marks, family income, category and course.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
description: Financial support for eligible girl students pursuing technical diploma or degree courses.
eligibility: Girl students admitted to eligible AICTE-approved institutions; income and family-level conditions apply.

title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship
description: Financial assistance for eligible students in specified vulnerable circumstances.
eligibility: Includes eligible orphans, students whose parents died due to COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces/CAPF personnel martyred in action, subject to scheme rules.

title: National Career Service (NCS)
description: Search for jobs, career counselling, job fairs and employment-related services.
eligibility: Depends on the job or event; opportunities may be available for students and freshers.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Loans for eligible small businesses and micro-enterprises, including certain allied agricultural activities.
eligibility: Entrepreneurs establishing or running an eligible micro-enterprise; lender requirements apply.

title: PM Vishwakarma
description: Training, toolkit support, affordable credit and marketing assistance for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
eligibility: Adults working in one of the 18 specified traditional trades, subject to scheme conditions.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Eligible families' hospital treatment coverage.
eligibility: Based on applicable beneficiary eligibility.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Housing assistance under the applicable urban or rural scheme.
eligibility: Depends on housing status, income and scheme rules.

title: PM-KISAN
description: Income support for eligible farmer families.
eligibility: Farmer-family eligibility and exclusion rules apply
